task: Read English text aloud and save the recording
packaging_note: Runs Kokoro locally with a pinned English voice, model and pronunciation resources. The sample is transcribed independently with Whisper.

inputs.what: English text in a UTF-8 text file

outputs.what: a spoken recording of your text

known_issues: English, American pronunciation, af_heart voice. The first image download includes the model; speech synthesis uses the CPU.
